title: Notice and hearing.
officialText:
The commissioner shall not revoke or suspend a license or certificate of competence for any
cause or impose any other sanction on a licensee unless and until the holder has been given at least five calendar days prior written
notice and an opportunity to be heard. However, when the public safety may be imminently jeopardized the commissioner shall
have the power, pending a hearing and determination of charges, to forthwith suspend any license for a period not exceeding 15
days.
